name: FormCraft
title: images, video, audio, 3D and worlds from models you choose
summary: FormCraft is a generation studio for images, video, audio, 3D and worlds: canvases, 3D scenes, moodboards and a multi-track timeline, on your own keys.
lede: FormCraft generates images, video, music, sound, 3D meshes and explorable worlds from one prompt bar, with the options each model really has. Canvases, 3D scenes, moodboards and a multi-track timeline sit in one window on your own computer. Generation runs on your own provider keys, kept in the system password store, with no account and no credits.
checks: Generates images, video, music, sound, 3D meshes and worlds from one prompt bar, using 122 catalogued models.
Stages a 3D scene with props and cameras, then turns the camera's frame into a still and a still into a clip.
Cuts video on a multi-track timeline with trim, split, ripple, snapping, keyframes and masks, and exports MP4 or WebM.
Serves 74 tools over MCP to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and keeps agents off until you allow them.

facts.dd: .fcrft files that carry their media, saved atomically
Vanilla TypeScript, Vite and Three.js in the window; Python and FastAPI for the engine; Tauri 2 for the desktop shell
fal and the World Labs API through their official APIs and your own keys
./formcraft mcp serves 74 tools: 44 engine tools and 30 studio tools

chapters.title: Stage the shot, then generate it
chapters.text: Block out a 3D scene with CC0 models, props and cameras. The camera's frame becomes a still, and a still becomes a clip, all from the prompt bar on the stage.

chapters.title: Cut on a multi-track timeline
chapters.text: The Edit studio has trim, split, ripple, snapping, keyframes and masks across overlay, main and audio tracks. Export to MP4 or WebM to disk and to the library.

chapters.title: Collect references and lay them out
chapters.text: Boards hold pictures, clips, notes, colours and links with sections, ratings, tags and a palette. Switch a board to a free canvas with groups, snapping and layout tools, and present it full screen.

.mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json are wired in the repository

topics.title: Where it runs
topics.text: The web UI is at http://localhost:5290 and the engine listens on 127.0.0.1:8290, loopback only.

topics.title: Environment variables
topics.text: FORMCRAFT_DATA_DIR sets where the library, jobs, settings and logs live, FORMCRAFT_PORT sets the engine port (0 picks a free one) and FORMCRAFT_MCP_URL makes formcraft mcp attach to the engine at that URL.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: All 24 planned phases have landed and the Linux build is checked. Generation was checked against the providers' published schemas and a mock, not against the live services, and the macOS and Windows builds are untested.

topics.title: Where things live
topics.text: frontend holds the window, backend the engine with providers, model catalogue, jobs, library and MCP server, src-tauri the desktop shell and setup the scripts behind ./formcraft.

topics.title: Releases
topics.text: All FormCraft builds are compiled and released from FormCompiler; the repository holds the source.
